# awscc_lambda_runtime_version (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Lambda::RuntimeVersion



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the runtime version.
- `compatibility` (Attributes) Compatibility matrix for the runtime version: supported integration models, architectures, and feature policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compatibility))
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the runtime version was created.
- `image_uri` (String) The URI of the OCI image to publish as this runtime version. Not returned in Read.
- `last_modified` (String) The timestamp when the runtime version was last modified.
- `name` (String) The version identifier (1-128 chars, alphanumeric plus _.-).
- `platforms` (Attributes Set) The OCI platforms resolved from the image manifest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--platforms))
- `release_notes` (String) Optional release notes for this runtime version. Updatable; removing it from the template clears the release notes.
- `resolved_uri` (String) The fully resolved (digest-pinned) image URI for this runtime version.
- `runtime_name` (String) The name of the parent runtime.
- `state` (String) The lifecycle state of the runtime version.

<a id="nestedatt--compatibility"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compatibility`

Read-Only:

- `architectures` (Set of String) Supported CPU architectures for the runtime version.
- `integration_models` (Set of String) Supported integration models for the runtime version.
- `managed_instances` (String) Whether the runtime version supports managed instances.


<a id="nestedatt--platforms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `platforms`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String)
- `digest` (String)
- `os` (String)
